title: Patch: a failed read on the Purchases page offers Try again, as the other screens do
thread:
**Issue #1774 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #1774: Patch: a failed read on the Purchases page offers Try again, as the other screens do Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means The Purchases page shows a player the pack odds and how close each of their pity counters is to paying out. If its first request to the server fails once, the page shows the error and stays stuck there, and the only way out is to reload the whole site. The other menus already offer a Try again button for this. Once built, Purchases does too. ## Why - `apps/web/src/routes/purchases.tsx:54-71`: its own `useRead` fetches once, with no attempt counter. On a failure (`:93-98`) it renders `

{read.message}

` and nothing else, and it ignores a stated rate-limit wait. - The page came with #1665, after #1706 had moved the other screens to `AccountError` with Try again. `routes/collection.tsx:57-90`'s `useRead` is the pattern: an `attempt` state, `readFailureOf(cause)` and a `retry`. ## Proposal Follow `collection.tsx`'s `useRead`: the hook gains an `attempt` and a `retry`, its failure keeps `readFailureOf(cause)`, and `Answered` renders `AccountError` (`apps/web/src/auth/AccountError.tsx`) with a new `purchasesTestid.retry(place)`. The existing load-error testid stays on the error. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/routes/purchases.tsx` - `apps/web/src/routes/purchases.test.tsx` ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] With `getPacks` rejecting once, the page shows the error and a Try again button. Clicking it reads again and shows the odds table and the pity rows. - [ ] A rate-limited failure says when to try again, as the other screens do through `readFailureOf`. - [ ] `purchasesTestid.loadError(place)` still marks the error. - [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/purchases.test.tsx` passes. ## Size and risks Small: one component and its test, about 30 lines, and no decision left. No risk beyond the page itself. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40072130485)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ **Goal.** When a read on `/purchases` (`GET /api/packs` or `GET /api/cosmetic-packs`) fails, its place shows the error and a Try again button, like the other screens' reads since #1691. Clicking it reads again and shows the answer: for packs, the odds table and the pity rows. A rate-limited failure says when to try again and keeps the button off until then, through `readFailureOf` and `AccountError`. `purchasesTestid.loadError(place)` still marks the error, and a new `purchasesTestid.retry(place)` marks the button. **Files to touch.** | Path | new/change | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/routes/purchases.tsx` | change | header comment; imports; `purchasesTestid.retry`; `Read`'s failed case; delete `wordsOf`; `useRead` gets an attempt counter and a retry; `Answered` renders `AccountError` | | `apps/web/src/routes/purchases.test.tsx` | change | a new `describe("#1774 …")` with two tests; one header comment line | Do not touch any other file: no CSS (`.row` and `.button-primary` are global in `apps/web/src/index.css`), not `apps/web/src/auth/AccountError.tsx`, not `apps/web/src/net/gate.ts`, nothing in `spec/`, `crates/`, `e2e/`, `.github/`, `.harness/` or `bot/`. The governing ruling is `spec/rulings/R1665000.md` ("A read that fails says why in its place"). It stays true and is not edited. The new tests cite no R-id, so `spec check` is unaffected. **Steps.** 1. `apps/web/src/routes/purchases.tsx`, header comment, line 8. Replace `A read that fails says why in its place.` with `A read that fails says why in its place and offers Try again (#1774), as the other screens' own reads do (#1691).` 2. Same file, imports. - Add `import { AccountError } from "../auth/AccountError.tsx";` directly above `import { t, useLocale } from "../i18n/i18n.ts";`. - Add `import { readFailureOf, type ReadFailure } from "../net/gate.ts";` directly below the `../net/api.ts` import. 3. Same file, `purchasesTestid`. Directly after the `loadError` line, add: ```ts retry: (place: PurchasesPlace) => `purchases-${place}-retry`, ``` 4. Same file, type `Read` and its doc comment. Replace both with: ```ts /** A read as the page shows it: waiting, answered, or refused with the words to show and Try again. */ type Read = | { kind: "loading" } | { kind: "ready"; value: T } | ({ kind: "failed"; retry: () => void } & ReadFailure); ``` Delete `wordsOf` with its doc comment (lines 48–51). `readFailureOf` replaces it, and nothing else uses it. 5. Same file, `useRead`. Copy the pattern of `useRead` in `apps/web/src/routes/collection.tsx:63-90`. - Keep the signature `useRead(token: string | null, read: (token: string) => Promise): Read` and the `if (token === null) return;` guard. - Change the doc comment to `` /** `read(token)` once the page has a token, and again each time Try again asks; never, without one. */ ``. - Add `const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0);` after the `state` line. - Replace the rejection handler with: ```ts (cause: unknown) => { if (cancelled) return; setState({ kind: "failed", ...readFailureOf(cause), retry: () => { setState({ kind: "loading" }); setAttempt((before) => before + 1); }, }); }, ``` - Change the effect's dependency array to `[token, read, attempt]`. 6. Same file, `Answered`. - Change its doc comment to `` /** `ready` where the read answered, else what it is waiting for, or why it failed with Try again, in the same place. */ ``. - Replace the body of `case "failed":` with: ```tsx return ( ); ``` - Leave `Published` unchanged. The packs read feeds two places (`card-packs` and `pity`), so a failed packs read shows the error and a Try again in each. Either button resets the one shared read, so both places show "Loading…" and then the answer together. 7. `apps/web/src/routes/purchases.test.tsx`, header comment. Append one line to the comment block: `// A read that fails offers Try again, which reads it again (#1774).` 8. Same file. Insert a new `describe` block between the end of `describe("R1665000 /purchases signed in", …)` and `describe("R1665000 /purchases signed out", …)`. It holds the two tests in **Tests**. Use only helpers the file already has: `stubServer`, `refusal`, `answers`, `signedIn`, `SLOW`, `PurchasesRoute`, `purchasesTestid`, `within`, `fireEvent`, and the type `Reply`. Add no imports. **Tests.** Both go in `apps/web/src/routes/purchases.test.tsx`, inside `describe("#1774 /purchases offers Try again", () => { … })`. 1. `it("#1774 a failed packs read offers Try again, which reads it again and shows the odds and the pity", async () => { … })` - Setup: - `let refused = false;` - `const server = stubServer((call) => { if (call.method === "GET" && call.path === "/api/packs" && !refused) { refused = true; return refusal(503, "internal", "the packs are closed"); } return answers(call); });` - Then `signedIn(); render();`. - Before the click: - `await screen.findByTestId(purchasesTestid.loadError("card-packs"), undefined, SLOW)` has text `"the packs are closed"`. - `getByTestId(purchasesTestid.loadError("pity"))` has the same text. - `getByTestId(purchasesTestid.retry("card-packs"))` and `getByTestId(purchasesTestid.retry("pity"))` are each `toBeEnabled()` and `toHaveTextContent("Try again")`. - `await screen.findByTestId(purchasesTestid.cosmeticSlot, undefined, SLOW)`, then `queryByTestId(purchasesTestid.retry("cosmetic-packs"))` is `null`. - Click: `fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId(purchasesTestid.retry("card-packs")));` - After the click: - `const odds = await screen.findByTestId(purchasesTestid.odds, undefined, SLOW);` then `within(odds).getByTestId(purchasesTestid.oddsRow("rare"))` has text `"Rare32%82%"`. - `await screen.findByTestId(purchasesTestid.pityRow("epic"), undefined, SLOW)` has text `"7 / 10 packs"`, and `getByTestId(purchasesTestid.pityLine)` is in the document. - `queryByTestId` is `null` for `loadError("card-packs")`, `loadError("pity")`, `retry("card-packs")` and `retry("pity")`. - `server.to("GET", "/api/packs")` has length 2, and `server.to("GET", "/api/cosmetic-packs")` has length 1. 2. `it("#1774 a rate-limited read says when to try again and holds Try again", async () => { … })` - Setup: - `const rateLimited: Reply = { status: 429, body: { error: { code: "rate_limited", message: "slow down", details: { retryAfterMs: 60_000 } } } };` (`net/api.ts`'s `errorBodyOf` reads `error.details`, so `retryAfterMsOf` sees the wait.) - `stubServer((call) => (call.method === "GET" && call.path === "/api/packs" ? rateLimited : answers(call)));` - Then `signedIn(); render();`. - Assertions: - `const error = await screen.findByTestId(purchasesTestid.loadError("card-packs"), undefined, SLOW);`. It has text `"slow down"` and matches `/You can try again in \d+ s\./`. - `getByTestId(purchasesTestid.loadError("pity"))` matches `/You can try again in \d+ s\./`. - For each `place` of `["card-packs", "pity"] as const`, `getByTestId(purchasesTestid.retry(place))` is `toBeDisabled()` and matches `/Try again in \d+ s/`. - This is the same pattern as `collection.test.tsx`'s `"#1691 a rate-limited panel holds Try again"`. Before this change, both tests fail: there is no retry testid and no wait sentence. The eight existing tests must still pass unchanged. `loadError(place)` now sits on `AccountError`'s `

`, whose text still contains the message. Commands. The first one is needed once per fresh worktree: without it vitest fails to resolve `src/wasm/pkg`. ``` sh scripts/build-wasm.sh pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/purchases.test.tsx pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/shop.test.tsx pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/routes/purchases.tsx apps/web/src/routes/purchases.test.tsx ``` The planner ran the baseline: after `build-wasm.sh`, `purchases.test.tsx` passes 8 of 8 on the base commit. **Done when.** - [ ] A failed packs read shows the error and an enabled Try again in both the card-packs and pity places. Clicking it reads `/api/packs` again and shows the odds table and the pity rows (test 1). - [ ] A rate-limited failure shows "You can try again in N s." and a disabled "Try again in N s" (test 2). - [ ] `purchasesTestid.loadError(place)` still marks the error, and all 8 existing tests pass unchanged. - [ ] `purchases.test.tsx` and `shop.test.tsx` pass; web typecheck and eslint are clean. - [ ] The harness checks listed for this run pass (rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests). No Rust or spec file is touched, so only the web tests can change. - [ ] Two tracked files changed, nothing else (`git status`). `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg/` is gitignored. **Risks.** - **Rule 7 (the client never enforces rules).** Nothing new is computed: the message and the wait are the server's, read by `readFailureOf`. This holds. - **Lint.** `attempt` appears only in the effect's dependency array, exactly as in `collection.tsx`, so `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` accepts it. Leaving `wordsOf` in place would fail the unused-symbol check, so delete it. - **Translation.** `AccountError` renders `t(message)`, not the raw message. In English an unknown sentence returns as is (`i18n.ts`'s `t`), so the existing text assertions hold. - **Extra requests.** Retrying a stale read issues no extra request: the existing `cancelled` flag drops a late answer, and the effect re-runs only when `attempt` changes. **Open questions.** None. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-24T06:49:21Z: approve ````
